crossRefs.note: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array, with all kinds of instruments…
crossRefs.keyword: expert in war. or, keeping their rank

crossRefs.note: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off…
crossRefs.keyword: expert in war. or, keeping their rank

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

translations.web: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.
translations.bsb: From Asher: 40,000 fit for service, prepared for battle.
translations.kjv: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
translations.asv: And of Asher, such as were able to go out in the host, that could set the battle in array, forty thousand.
